note: Kenya: every non-citizen needs an entry or work permit, or an exemption, before taking up employment, paid or unpaid; one coming for a short assignment such as a performance, paid or unpaid, needs a Special Pass from the Director of Immigration Services (the Department's notice, reproduced by Music in Africa). The East African Community's arrangements for its partner states' citizens aren't modelled separately yet. No days of performing without the pass are named.

sources.title: Music in Africa, Kenya: Work/Entry Permit (reproducing the Department of Immigration Services' notice)
sources.said: Please note that all non-Kenyan citizens must be in possession of an entry/work permit or exemption, issued by the Office of the Director of Immigration Services, before they can take up employment in Kenya, whether paid or unpaid. Non-Kenyans wanting to carry out short term business assignments like assembling machinery, maintenance or performance whether paid or unpaid must obtain a Kenya Special Pass from The Director of Immigration Services.
